title: 第5章矿场主不是人第6章三日苦修
slug: 矿奴开局八极拳打穿三十六重天
content_zh:
苏意领着三十余名矿奴，在深山坳里隐匿了两日。
这两日间，他运转淬火锻身诀自行疗伤。
双臂间矿煞毒素残留的麻痹感，在第一夜便消散殆尽。
脚底板的狰狞烫伤，结了一层厚实硬痂。
前臂被矿煞利爪划出的五道伤口，在自身气血冲刷下已然收口，只留下五道淡粉的新生肉痕。
矿奴们砍伐枝木，搭建起简陋的窝棚。
又掘采山野野菜，熬煮清汤勉强果腹。
苏意将从牛皋身上得来的那串钥匙，分给几名身强力壮的矿奴当作兵器。
钥匙棱角被磨得锋利，攥在指缝之间，一拳打出，便能轻易撕裂皮肉。
第三日清晨，苏意倏然转醒。
并非自然睡醒。
而是被刺骨寒意，生生冻醒的。
七月盛夏，山坳里的气温在一瞬间骤降至冰点。
口鼻呼出的气息，转瞬凝成白茫茫的白雾。
窝棚顶端，悄然凝上一层薄薄的白霜。
矿奴们冻得蜷缩成团，有人牙关不住磕碰，发出咯咯的脆响。
苏意缓缓起身，将怀中揣着的半块黑面饼，递给了赵老蔫。
就在这时，他目光一凝，看见了那道身影。
白衣女子静立在山坳入口，白衣胜雪，长发如瀑垂落肩头。
容颜精致绝美，全然不似深山矿山之人，反倒像大宗门精心教养出的女修。

可她嘴角噙着的笑意，却透着几分诡异。
那不是待人处世的温和笑意，而是捕食者俯瞰猎物时，才会流露的漠然与玩味。
一双瞳孔呈琥珀竖瞳，冰冷狭长，宛若蛇瞳一般。
柳晴。
“你倒是不跑。”
她轻启朱唇，语声并不高昂，却字字清晰落进苏意耳中，像有人贴着耳廓低语。
“跑不掉。”
苏意沉声说。
“聪明。”
柳晴悠然往前踏出一步。
这一步横跨三丈之遥，白衣随风轻扬，步履从容，转瞬便站到了苏意面前。
她比苏意矮了半个头，微微仰头看向他，竖瞳在晨光里轻轻收缩。
“牛皋是你杀的？”
“是。”
“牛能也是你杀的？”
content_en:
Su Yi led more than 30 mining slaves and hid in the deep mountains for two days.
During these two days, he used the Tempering Body Strengthening Technique to heal his injuries on his own.
The residual numbness of the mine poison between his arms dissipated on the first night.
The soles of the feet were badly burned and formed a layer of thick hard scabs.
The five wounds on his forearm that were scratched by the sharp claws of the mine demon have been closed under the erosion of his own energy and blood, leaving only five pale pink marks of new flesh.
The mine slaves cut down branches and trees and built crude shacks.
He also dug wild vegetables and cooked clear soup to satisfy his hunger.
Su Yi distributed the bunch of keys obtained from Niu Gao to several strong mining slaves as weapons.
The edges of the key are sharpened, and if you hold it between your fingers, you can easily tear the flesh with a punch.
In the early morning of the third day, Su Yi suddenly woke up.
It's not like waking up naturally.
Instead, he was woken up by the biting cold.
In the midsummer of July, the temperature in the mountain col dropped to freezing point in an instant.
The breath exhaled from the mouth and nose suddenly condensed into a white mist.
A thin layer of white frost quietly condensed on the top of the shack.
The mine slaves huddled up in a ball due to the cold, and some of them chatted with their teeth, making a crunching sound.
Su Yi stood up slowly and handed half of the black noodle cake in her arms to Zhao Laowen.
At this moment, his eyes narrowed and he saw the figure.
A woman in white clothes stands quietly at the entrance of the mountain col. Her white clothes are as white as the snow, and her long hair falls like a waterfall on her shoulders.
Her face is delicate and beautiful. She doesn't look like someone from the mountains and mines at all. Instead, she looks like a female cultivator carefully raised by a large sect.
But the smile on her lips was a bit strange.
It was not a gentle smile when dealing with others, but the indifference and amusement that a predator would show when looking down at its prey.
A pair of amber vertical pupils, cold and narrow, like snake eyes.
Liu Qing.
"You don't want to run."
She opened her red lips lightly, and her voice was not high-pitched, but the words fell into Su Yi's ears clearly, like someone whispering against the shell of her ear.
"Can't run away."
Su Yi said in a deep voice.
"Smart."
Liu Qing took a step forward leisurely.
This step spanned a distance of three feet. His white clothes fluttered in the wind, and he walked calmly. In an instant, he stood in front of Su Yi.
She was half a head shorter than Su Yi. She raised her head slightly and looked at him, her vertical pupils shrinking slightly in the morning light.
"Did you kill Niu Gao?"
"Yes."
"Neng Niu was also killed by you?"
